seoTitle: Fort Bend ISD Calendar 2026-2027: First Day, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fort Bend ISD Calendar 2026-2027 includes the Aug 11 first day, May 27 last day, holidays, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, early release dates, PDF and ICS download.
breaksTitle: Fort Bend ISD Holidays and School Breaks
heroSummary: Fort Bend ISD calendar 2026-2027 starts Tuesday, August 11, 2026 and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. The calendar includes 172 instructional days, 187 teacher contract days, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, early release dates, grading periods, official PDF download, and calendar import options.
calendarNotes: Fort Bend ISD begins the 2026-2027 school year on August 11, 2026. Fall Break runs October 12-16, Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, and Winter Break runs December 21-January 1. Students return for the second semester on January 6, 2027 after professional learning and teacher planning days. Spring Break runs March 8-12, with an additional student/teacher holiday on March 26 and a possible inclement weather make-up day on April 30. The school year ends with early release for all students on May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fort Bend ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fort Bend ISD starts the 2026-2027 school year on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 12 through Friday, October 16, 2026. October 9 is a teacher planning day with no students, so families should also mark the Friday before the break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Winter Break 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return for second semester classes on Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Fort Bend ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 8 through Friday, March 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fort Bend ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar lists 172 total days of instruction and 187 total teacher contract days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fort Bend ISD have inclement weather make-up days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar labels February 15 and April 30, 2027 as student/teacher holidays and inclement weather make-up days. Families should re-check Fort Bend ISD announcements after closures because those dates may be used to recover instructional time.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar PDF is linked on this page from the district calendar source.

customSections.label: Fort Bend ISD Calendar Download and Print Guide
customSections.content: Use the official PDF when you need a printable Fort Bend ISD calendar, and use the ICS file when you want to add major dates to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Calendar imports are one-time downloads, so families should re-check Fort Bend ISD before relying on dates for urgent plans.

customSections.label: What Makes the Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 Calendar Useful
customSections.content: This section explains the Fort Bend ISD calendar features families should understand after checking the quick date timeline. It focuses on schedule structure rather than repeating the same first day, last day, and break dates.

groups.label: Calendar structure
items: Four nine-week grading periods divide the school year into two semesters.
Teacher planning and professional learning days create no-student days outside the major breaks.
Early release dates are split by elementary, middle/high school, and all-student schedules.
Weather make-up dates may become instructional days if the district needs to recover time.

groups.label: Important planning notes
items: October 9 is a teacher planning day with no students, immediately before Fall Break.
December 17 is early release for middle and high schools; December 18 is early release for all students.
February 15 and April 30 are listed as inclement weather make-up days, so they may require re-checking after closures.
May 26 is early release for middle and high schools; May 27 is early release for all students and the last student day.
